mechanism_narrative: Elevated federal funds rate levels increase the cost of capital for corporations, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is greater than or equal to 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 207.0) signals potential monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 207.0, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (above 5.0%) and low unemployment rate (below 5.0%) signals an over-tightened monetary policy that is likely to trigger a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 5.0%), strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k) signals robust corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC between the trigger condition and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1400 thousand units) signals robust consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC between HOUST and returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 207.0) over the past 3 months compresses real equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 207.0, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 60d returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between GDPC1 and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 112.0) signals weakening manufacturing activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 112.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d returns is below 0.03.
